notes: A fresh look for every E-Sys MAX window inside E-Sys, the same as the launcher: clear titles, one orange button for the main step, coloured results at a glance (faults, finished jobs, valid FSCs) and quieter lists. Full backup zips can be locked with a password (Settings, Backups; off unless you switch it on). Open them with 7-Zip or WinRAR; with it on, the cloud copy takes only the locked zip. NCD compare: right-click a setting to save it as a cheat with either file's value, and ticks now follow Swap across CAFD versions. Safer re-apply and Code several changes: re-apply reads each file's names for its own CAFD version and puts back only the bits it changed, and Code several changes never codes from a coding file it already used, puts each module's edit into E-Sys's coding folder only right before that module is coded, and waits for E-Sys to finish before putting files back. After coding also checks the coded modules on remote and ICOM connections. Connection check and Find ICOM are steadier, and battery registration waits for a new reading before it offers to register again. Code several changes keeps a module that E-Sys coded with no errors marked as coded, even when a later step fails. NCD compare shows value names once ("three times", not "three time"), and windows keep their look when E-Sys switches between light and dark. NCD compare and re-apply are quicker on big modules.
